newsitem.title: USA: Core Industries Inc sells Poly Craft unit.
newsitem.headline: Core Industries Inc sells Poly Craft unit.

text.p: Core Industries Inc said on Friday it had sold its plastic injection molding subsidiary, Poly Craft Inc, to an unnamed privately owned company that will operate the business under the name Small Parts Inc - Napco Division.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Core chief financial officer Mark MacGuidwin said Poly Craft was one of the company's smallest units, with annual sales of less than $7 million, and that it had failed to earn its cost of capital in recent years.
"This divestiture will free up resources which will be redirected to Core's strategic business areas," he said.
Core Industries Inc manufactures specialty products in three segments: Fluid Controls and Construction Products; Test, Measurement and Control; and Farm Equipment.
